template: e = winsorize(ts_backfill({factor_e}, 252), 4); s = winsorize(ts_backfill({factor_s}, 252), 4); g = winsorize(ts_backfill({factor_g}, 252), 4); de = days_from_last_change(e); ds = days_from_last_change(s); dg = days_from_last_change(g); nan_cnt = add(add(ts_count_nans(e, 63), ts_count_nans(s, 63)), ts_count_nans(g, 63)); recency = min(min(de, ds), dg); is_fresh = less(recency, 30); change_mag = add(add(abs(subtract(e, last_diff_value(e, de))), abs(subtract(s, last_diff_value(s, ds)))), abs(subtract(g, last_diff_value(g, dg)))); level = add(add(group_zscore(e, industry), group_zscore(s, industry)), group_zscore(g, industry)); core = trade_when(is_fresh, multiply(change_mag, sign(level)), multiply(subtract(1, multiply(0.01, nan_cnt)), ts_decay_linear(level, 20)))
idea: 数据新鲜度加权与事件驱动模型。利用days_from_last_change检测最近30天内是否有任一ESG维度发生评级变更，若有则采用变更幅度（last_diff_value）作为事件强度信号，方向由当前水平决定；若无近期变更，则采用20日线性衰减的平均水平，并根据过去63天缺失值计数（nan_cnt）进行折扣惩罚。该模板解决了ESG数据披露频率不一、Stale数据风险高的问题，优先交易近期有实质性披露更新的标的。
